svg.title: MATRIX → STEERIX · Continuous burst (reverse)
svg.desc: White logos on pure black. The supplied STEERIX → MATRIX burst played backwards over its transition: MATRI fades out from the I back to the M, the six parts of the X burst apart and gather into the STEERIX symbol while STEERIX slides in from the right. Splines are mirrored. 2.6 second SVG timeline, plays once and holds STEERIX. Vector paths only; no scripts or external assets.
